content.title: NBA Playoffs 2026: Schedule, results, and scores - full list
content.text: The 2026 NBA Playoffs begin on 18 April after the completion of the Eastern and Western Conference brackets via the Play-In Tournament. Check out the latest schedule, results, and scores from every stage of the postseason herePicture by Justin Ford/Getty ImagesBy Will ImboUpdated on 22 April 2026 05:21 GMT+06 min readThe race for the 2026 Larry O’Brien Trophy is on, with the full 16-team bracket for the National Basketball Association (NBA) playoffs set following Friday’s final play-in games. The Oklahoma City Thunder enter as defending champions and the top seed in the Western Conference, while the Detroit Pistons lead the East as the No. 1 seed. The playoffs begin with the opening games of the first round on Saturday, 18 April, and conclude with the best-of-seven NBA Finals, which are scheduled to tip off on 3 June.
